situations.title: 초기 복통 문진
situations.tagline: My stomach has been hurting since this morning and I'm not sure why.
situations.brief: OPQRST로 복통의 발현·위치·방사 양상을 기초 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the pain first start today?
Can you show me where it hurts the most?
Does the pain move or spread anywhere else?

situations.title: 활력·통증척도 사정
situations.tagline: The pain is about a seven, and I haven't been able to eat anything.
situations.brief: 활력징후와 0~10 통증척도를 사정하고 금식(NPO) 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain right now?
When was the last time you ate or drank anything?
I'm going to check your blood pressure and temperature.

situations.title: 우하복부 압통(충수염 의심)
situations.tagline: The pain started near my belly button and now it's down on the right.
situations.brief: 복통의 이동 양상과 반발통을 사정하고 외과 협진을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you point to exactly where it hurts the most?
Does it hurt more when I press or when I let go?
When did you last eat or drink anything?

situations.title: 소화불량성 복통 감별
situations.tagline: It feels like really bad indigestion, but I've never had it this strong.
situations.brief: 단순 소화불량과 응급 복통을 감별하기 위한 위험신호를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Is the pain more of a burning or a sharp feeling?
Does it get better or worse after you eat?
Have you had any chest pain, sweating, or shortness of breath?

situations.title: 변비성 복통 노인
situations.tagline: I haven't had a bowel movement in almost a week and my belly is bloated.
situations.brief: 노인의 배변력과 최근 식이·수분 섭취를 사정하고 복부 팽만을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When was your last bowel movement?
Have you been drinking and eating normally lately?
Are you passing any gas at all?

situations.title: 담석 산통(RUQ)
situations.tagline: The pain in my upper right side came on after a greasy dinner.
situations.brief: 지방식 후 우상복부 산통과 Murphy 징후를 사정하고 초음파를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Did the pain start after a fatty or heavy meal?
Does it hurt when I press here as you breathe in?
Does the pain spread to your back or right shoulder?
goals: 지방식 후 RUQ 산통과 Murphy 징후를 사정한다

situations.title: 급성 췌장염(음주력)
situations.tagline: The pain goes straight through to my back and I've been drinking a lot lately.
situations.brief: 상복부 방사통과 음주력을 사정하고 금식·수액 계획을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Does the pain go through to your back?
How much alcohol have you been drinking recently?
We'll need to keep you from eating or drinking for now.

situations.title: 게실염 좌하복부
situations.tagline: It's a constant ache low on my left side, and I've had a fever.
situations.brief: 좌하복부 통증과 발열을 사정하고 CT 조영·경구조영제 준비를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Is the pain low on your left side?
Have you had any fever, chills, or change in your stools?
You may need to drink a contrast liquid before the CT scan.

situations.title: 소장 폐색(수술력)
situations.tagline: I keep throwing up and my belly is swollen — I've had surgery before.
situations.brief: 구토·복부 팽만과 과거 수술력을 사정하고 NG튜브 필요성을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you had any abdominal surgeries in the past?
Are you able to pass gas or have a bowel movement?
We may need to place a tube through your nose to relieve the pressure.

situations.title: 신우신염 동반 복통 여성
situations.tagline: My side and back hurt, and it burns when I pee.
situations.brief: 옆구리·CVA 압통과 배뇨 증상을 사정하고 소변검사를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Does it hurt when I tap on your back here?
Do you have any burning or pain when you urinate?
We'll need a urine sample to check for infection.

situations.title: 임신 가능 여성 복통
situations.tagline: My lower belly hurts and my period is late this month.
situations.brief: 월경력을 확인하고 가임 여성의 복통에서 임신검사의 필요성을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: When was your last menstrual period?
Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
We'll do a pregnancy test as part of checking your belly pain.

situations.title: 이소성 임신 감별
situations.tagline: I'm dizzy, my belly hurts, and I've had some spotting.
situations.brief: 어지럼·질출혈 등 이소성 임신의 위험신호를 사정하고 신속 검사를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you noticed any vaginal bleeding or spotting?
Do you feel lightheaded or like you might faint?
We need to check right away whether you could be pregnant.

situations.title: 복통+언어장벽
situations.tagline: It hurts here... I don't speak much English, sorry.
situations.brief: 통역 지원과 손짓을 활용해 통증 위치를 확인하며 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get an interpreter so we can understand you better.
Can you point to where it hurts the most?
Please nod yes or shake your head no.

situations.title: 오피오이드 남용 의심 복통
situations.tagline: My stomach is killing me — I really need something strong for the pain.
situations.brief: 비판단적 태도로 통증을 사정하고 약물 사용력을 안전하게 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: I want to understand your pain so we can help you safely.
What medications have you taken for this already?
We'll assess you fully before deciding on treatment.

situations.title: 노인 비전형 복통
situations.tagline: It's just a little upset stomach, nothing serious, I think.
situations.brief: 통증을 축소하는 노인에서 미묘한 징후와 활력 변화를 세심히 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Sometimes serious problems can feel mild, so I want to check carefully.
Have you had any nausea, weakness, or dizziness?
Let me recheck your vital signs to be safe.
goals: 축소된 통증 뒤의 미묘한 징후를 사정한다

situations.title: 대동맥류 파열(찢는 통증)
situations.tagline: It feels like something is tearing in my belly and back.
situations.brief: 찢는 통증·박동성 종괴·저혈압을 인지하고 대량수혈과 긴급 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Is the pain tearing or ripping in quality?
We're moving fast because this could be very serious.
We're calling the surgeon and preparing blood right now.

situations.title: 장간막 허혈
situations.tagline: The pain is unbearable, but the doctor said my belly feels almost soft.
situations.brief: 진찰 소견 대비 극심한 통증의 불일치를 인지하고 젖산·CT를 신속히 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Your pain is much worse than what we feel on exam — that concerns us.
We're drawing a lactate level right away.
You'll need an urgent CT scan of your belly.

situations.title: 천공성 궤양(판자복부)
situations.tagline: My whole belly is rigid and any movement makes it agony.
situations.brief: 판자복부와 기복증·패혈증 징후를 인지하고 SBAR로 외과에 긴급 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Your belly is very rigid, which is a serious sign.
We're going to keep you flat and still to reduce the pain.
I'm calling the surgeon now with an SBAR report.

situations.title: 담관염(Charcot 3징)
situations.tagline: I have a fever, my eyes look yellow, and my right side hurts badly.
situations.brief: 발열·황달·RUQ 통증의 삼징을 인지하고 ERCP·항생제 준비를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you noticed your skin or eyes turning yellow?
You have a fever and right-sided pain that we take seriously.
You may need a procedure called ERCP to drain the bile duct.

situations.title: 급성 복증 급속악화
situations.tagline: I was okay an hour ago, but now I feel like I'm going to pass out.
situations.brief: 활력징후 붕괴를 인지하고 긴급 호출과 초기 소생 팀을 가동하세요.
keyPhrases: Your blood pressure has dropped, so we're acting quickly.
Stay with me — I'm calling for the team right now.
We're starting fluids and oxygen immediately.

situations.title: 다발외상 동반 복강내출혈
situations.tagline: I was in a car crash and my belly really hurts.
situations.brief: FAST 초음파와 활력을 통합 사정하고 수혈·외상팀 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're doing a quick ultrasound of your belly called a FAST exam.
Tell me where you hurt the most from the crash.
We're getting blood ready in case you need a transfusion.
